ProductName: Paul Mitchell Moisture Awapuhi Moisture Mist 250ml
Description: Deeply hydrates thirsty hair and revives dry, tired skin.

Lactic acid and Hawaiian awapuhi provide deep moisture and enhanced shine. Spirulina and plankton extracts rich in amino acids and vitamins make hair soft, hydrated and silky smooth, while sodium PCA balances moisture.
Spray generously on hair and skin.
Reactivates styling products in hair, making it perfect for quick touch-ups.
